notes: עַד־אֶחָד is divided as an unrepresented עַד beside אֶחָד rendered *a man* (rules 40, 31).

The head of that unit stands on *man* and not on the indefinite article, which rule 31's closing sentence forecloses in any case (where the phrase also carries an article, of, or a, they are never the head); the accepted note's competing reading is therefore not open.
